active_contract.scale_rule: Scale labels are aggregation/coordination roles, not universal numeric caps; only individual owns constituent truth and SCL-02 owns later composition definitions.
active_contract.projection_rule: All up-scale projections retain explicit canonical ids/provenance and cannot duplicate or fork owner-domain state/effects.
active_contract.reconciliation_rule: SCL-01 performs no down-scale mutation; later results reconcile through explicit owner-domain proposals/commits with SCL-09 primary for casualty/damage and no double application.
active_contract.visibility_rule: Authorization filtering occurs before inclusion/counts/aggregation/provenance/receipts/AI context; hidden existence/cardinality remains undisclosed.
active_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, hidden, conflicting or identity-incompatible evidence remains explicit unresolved/conflict/incompatible and is never auto-promoted.
